Disclaimer* Serco Group PLC 01 October 2026 1 October 2026 Legal Entity Identifier: 549300PT2CIHYN5GWJ21 Serco Group plc Transactions in own shares and Total Voting Rights Serco Group plc (the " Company ") announces that, in accordance with the terms of its share buyback programme (the " Programme ") announced on 11 August 2026, it has purchased the following number of its ordinary shares of 2 pence each (" Ordinary Shares ") through RBC Europe Limited. Date of purchase: Number of Ordinary Shares purchased: Average price paid per Share (pence): Lowest price paid per Share (pence): Highest price paid per Share (pence): 28-Sep-2026 300,000 254.8191 253.4000 255.6000 29-Sep-2026 277,263 251.0381 246.2000 253.4000 30-Sep-2026 288,867 253.2488 251.8000 254.2000 Following the above transactions, the Company will have 963,786,023 Ordinary Shares in issue (excluding treasury shares). The total number of Ordinary Shares held in treasury is 38,959,991 . The total number of voting rights in the Company, excluding treasury shares as at 30 September 2026 is 963,786,023 . This figure may be used by shareholders (and others with notification obligations) as the denominator for the calculations by which they will determine if they are required to notify their interest in, or a change to their interest in, Company or its Group under the Financial Conduct Authority's Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rules. Since the announcement of the Programme on 11 August 2026, the Company has purchased a total of 10,509,526 Ordinary Shares, which are held in treasury.
